heading: From our *Crews*
intro: After every class, we ask our Crews a few quick questions. Here is what they have told us, in their own words.

testimonials.quote: Stacy and Noah are so friendly and welcoming! I really appreciate their patience with me and my friends throughout the whole experience, as we are not all at the Top Chef level! We all had such a blast and loved learning about the origin story of the ingredients we used.
testimonials.name: Guest

testimonials.quote: I loved making new friends while learning new recipes! Starting with strangers and ending with sharing a meal with new friends and enjoying food we created together. Loved the entire experience!
testimonials.name: Guest

testimonials.quote: So many things. Cooking and learning with Stacy, new friends, new ingredients, new kitchen gadgets. Meals should always be this great experience.

testimonials.quote: The recipes were a great difficulty level, the intro was informative, and doing it in pairs made it more fun and collaborative!
